nang sgrub drag mo khros ma sku mdog kham nag spyan gsum gsad pa'i dus su drag mo gong dang 'dra ba la/ral pa ༈dgra la thun 'gyed pa'i dus ral pa dmar ser

tei:div.tei:p: nang sgrub drag mo khros ma sku mdog kham nag spyan gsum gsad pa'i dus su drag mo gong dang 'dra ba la/ ral pa ༈ dgra la thun 'gyed pa'i dus ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu nu ma 'phyang zhing*/ dar gyi smad thur 'phyang g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod khrag / de dang 'dra ba las sku mdog g.yogs can/ phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon thod khrag stob pa'i tshul/ zhabs 'dor stabs dgra bgegs brdzis pa/ dmar nag ral pa thur du 'phyang rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan cha phyag zhabs gdu bu 'khrol cing thod skam gyis ༈ 'khor lo 'di dang mtshan bla rdo/ 'khor lo sku rgyab khebs pa/ g.yas nad dbu brgyan pa bong bu ser nag gdong dmar la 'chib pa'o/ sangs rgyas 'di ru gzhug /mchan khung g.yon du bcang*/ rkyal sbrul gyi gdengs ka gsum ldan/ so gnyis kyi mtshan dang mnyam du dril nas lus la bcang ngo*// g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa'o//
